data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): task-decomposer is READ-ONLY (cannot read ticket comments) and carries its own embedded protocol (does NOT load SKILL.md sub-sections at dispatch). Wiring {feature-flags-marker} ONLY in SKILL.md prose means the agent never sees it. d666 MUST (a) add {feature-flags-marker} to the EXPLICIT Step 3 dispatch 'Pass the following as task arguments' bullet list in SKILL.md, AND (b) add a matching input section (e.g. '### Feature-Flags Marker') in plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md '## Inputs' parallel to {testing-mode}. Verify: grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
